statement: a-priori round-off bound of route A (time stepping, fptlib.Stepper): every computed f(t) lies within the factors (1 -/+ delta)^t (1 -/+ u)^(m-1) of the exact value, delta = (1+u)^(2d+1)(1+e) - 1; the computed maximiser is certified when every other computed value, inflated by these factors, stays below the deflated maximum
